planUpgrade.title: LLC Planning and Design - Upgrade
planUpgrade.description: Plan your LLC before forming it - Comprehensive consulting. Not every LLC should be structured the same way.
lista: We determine which U.S. state is most suitable for forming your LLC based on your business activity, location, customers, costs, and obligations.
We analyze how your LLC should be taxed and which tax classification may be best suited to your structure and business model.
planUpgrade.popoverDescription: Our LLC Planning and Design service is intended to help you properly define your structure before forming it. Before forming a company in the United States, there are legal, tax, administrative, and accounting decisions that can directly affect how it operates, its annual obligations, and the way you will be able to conduct business.
